admissionInfo.note: Meeting minimum admissions criteria does not guarantee admission to the graduate program or to the University as a graduate student.
admissionInfo.text: 1. Application for admission to graduate program with application fee by the established deadline. 2. Submit official transcripts from all universities attended. 3. A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited college or university, a nationally accredited program, or an international college or university recognized by a ministry of education. 4. A minimum 3.4 cumulative GPA on a 4.0 scale. 5. The bachelor’s degree can be in any discipline, provided the student meets the prerequisite coursework which includes: General or Introductory Psychology Abnormal Psychology Introduction to Counseling (or equivalent) Research Methods Statistics 6. The university uses a selective admissions process for admitting students to graduate programs. Meeting minimum admissions criteria does not guarantee admission to the graduate program or to the University as a graduate student. 7. For international students whose native language is not English, submit official TOEFL or IELTS band scores. A TOEFL score of 79 iBT (550 pBT) or higher, or an IELTS band score of 6.0 or higher within the past two years is required. 8. International students must also meet all US government requirements for international students. Complete the UVU Graduate School Application. Personal Interview All candidates will be screened and those deemed to meet or exceed basic application requirements may be invited for an interview.
